relations.subject: Trevor Pryce Leggett
relations.evidence: He also studied law at university, graduating with a degree from the University of London in 1934.

relations.subject: Trevor Pryce Leggett
relations.evidence: In 1936, he met Hari Prasad Shastri, a teacher of Adhyatma Yoga who, like Tani, would have a significant impact on him. Shastri became his teacher of yoga and its philosophy.

relations.subject: Trevor Pryce Leggett
relations.object: School of Oriental and African Studies
relations.evidence: Leggett joined the Ministry of Information and attended a Japanese language refresher course at the School of Oriental and African Studies.

relations.subject: Trevor Pryce Leggett
relations.evidence: Given his degree of fluency, he received private classes with renowned academic Arthur Waley.

relations.subject: Trevor Pryce Leggett
